definitions.explanation: From a specific point in the past until now.

examples.japanese: {卒業|そつぎょう}{以来|いらい}、{会|あ}っていない。
examples.english: I haven't seen them since graduation.

examples.japanese: {去年|きょねん}{以来|いらい}のことだ。
examples.english: It's the first time since last year.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}の{頃|ころ}{以来|いらい}だ。
examples.english: It's the first time since I was a child.

examples.japanese: {結婚|けっこん}{以来|いらい}、{幸|しあわ}せです。
examples.english: I've been happy since getting married.

examples.japanese: {今日|きょう}{以来|いらい}、{禁煙|きんえん}します。
examples.english: From today onwards, I'll quit smoking.

examples.japanese: {会|あ}って{以来|いらい}、ずっと{友達|ともだち}だ。
examples.english: We've been friends ever since we met.

examples.japanese: これ{以来|いらい}、{注意|ちゅうい}するようにしている。
examples.english: From then on, I've been careful.

examples.japanese: {入社|にゅうしゃ}{以来|いらい}10{年|ねん}になる。
examples.english: It's been 10 years since I joined the company.

examples.japanese: {今|いま}{以来|いらい}、{連絡|れんらく}を{取|と}り{合|あ}おう。
examples.english: Let's keep in touch from now on.

examples.japanese: {事故|じこ}{以来|いらい}、{車|くるま}を{運転|うんてん}していない。
examples.english: I haven't driven since the accident.

examples.japanese: この{失敗|しっぱい}{以来|いらい}、もっと{慎重|しんちょう}に{行動|こうどう}するようになった。
examples.english: Since this failure, I've started acting more carefully.

examples.japanese: {先月|せんげつ}{以来|いらい}、{毎日|まいにち}{運動|うんどう}を{続|つづ}けている。
examples.english: Since last month, I've been exercising every day.

notes:
{以来|いらい} indicates "since" a specific time.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- X{以来|いらい} (since X)
- 〜て{以来|いらい} (since doing ~)
- {以来|いらい}ずっと (ever since then)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {以来|いらい}: since (continuing until now)
- {以後|いご}: after, from then on (forward-looking)
- {以降|いこう}: from ~ onward (often written)

NOTE:
- Different from {依頼|いらい} (request) - same reading, different kanji
